{{Quote|I found her sneaking around the cage.|The Zygerrian guard to [[Raney]]|<ref name="Rampage" />}}
A '''Zygerrian guard''' operated under the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]]. The guard served under [[Raney]] in [[Old Ord Mantell City]] on [[Ord Mantell]]. After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba's]] pet [[rancor]], [[Muchi]], was kidnapped by the [[enslaver]]s, [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] sent out [[Clone Force 99]] to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|rescue Muchi]]. The mission failed, as almost all of [[Cloning|Clone]] Force 99 was captured, except for [[Omega]]. Omega, trying to free her team from captivity, tried to release Muchi, but this guard stopped her and dragged her over to Raney. The guard claimed that she was sneaking around, only for Omega to remark she wasn't sneaking, but unlocking Muchi's cage. The guard and two other [[Zygerrian]]s tried to hold down the cage doors, but failed as Muchi escaped and caused havoc amongst the Zygerrian slavers. Clone Force 99 then saved the other slaves and escaped with Muchi, giving him to [[Bib Fortuna]] to take back to Jabba the [[Hutt]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Zygerrian guard appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]],"<ref name="Rampage" /> the fifth episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 28]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Sam Riegel]].<ref name="Rampage" />
